Calculate average nondemographic stock over the assessment horizon

Source: R/core_model_nondemographic_herd.R
calc_nondemo_avg_stock_phase_horizon.Rd

Computes annual average stock for a full productive phase, including animals that entered before the assessment year.

Usage

calc_nondemo_avg_stock_phase_horizon(
  full_nondemo_phase,
  total_nondemo_cycle_starts_to_distribute
)

Arguments

full_nondemo_phase

List. Output of calc_nondemo_phase() for a full productive phase. Must contain time_simulated_nondemographic (days) and cohort_stock_nondemo$start and cohort_stock_nondemo$end (heads).

total_nondemo_cycle_starts_to_distribute

Numeric. Annual cycle starts, calculated by calc_nondemo_cycle_geometry() and passed internally by run_nondemographic_herd_module().

Value

A named list with:

cohort_stock_size_unscaled

Numeric. Annual average population in the phase (heads), before rescaling to herd_size_total.

Details

The model calculates cycle starts from the phase and rest durations. No additional input-table field is required for this value.

For one full phase, animal-days are approximated using the trapezoidal rule: $$ full\_phase\_days = full_nondemo_phase$time_simulated_nondemographic \times \frac{ full_nondemo_phase$cohort_stock_nondemo$start + full_nondemo_phase$cohort_stock_nondemo$end }{2} $$

Annual average stock is then: $$ average\_stock\_phase\_horizon = \frac{total\_nondemo\_cycle\_starts\_to\_distribute \times full\_phase\_days}{365} $$

Full-phase stock is used even when no complete cycle fits within 365 days. This represents an established herd with animals from previous arrival years. A zero-duration phase contributes zero stock.

The calculation assumes linear stock change within each phase and applies no rounding. Fractional average stock values may occur.

This function is part of run_nondemographic_herd_module().

See also

run_nondemographic_herd_module()
